sup.stockout.subject: Urgent supply request – {item:item}
sup.stockout.body:
Dear {supplier} team,

Our stock of {item:item} is {onhand:n0} {unit:unit} (about {cover:n1} weeks of cover) and demand is rising. Please confirm the earliest delivery date and the quantity you can supply within {lead:n0} days, ideally with expedited shipping.

Best regards,
Procurement
sup.delay.subject: Urgent follow-up – delayed PO {po} ({item:item})
sup.delay.body:
Dear {supplier} team,

Our order {po} for {qty:n0} {unit:unit} of {item:item}, placed on {order_date:date}, is now delayed to {eta:date}. Our stock is only {onhand:n0} {unit:unit} (about {cover:n1} weeks of cover) and production would stop in about {hours:n0} hours.

Please (1) confirm a firm delivery date and (2) ship a partial delivery of the first available quantity immediately.
sup.delay.alt:
As a temporary alternative we can also take {alt:item}; please quote availability and lead time.

Best regards,
Procurement
sup.safety.subject: Priority order – {item:item}
sup.safety.body:
Dear {supplier} team,

Our stock of {item:item} is {onhand:n0} {unit:unit}, below our safety level of {ss:n0}. Please prioritise our next order and confirm the delivery date.

Best regards,
Procurement
